Our Story

Built by a family who lived the need.

John and Chelsea are a young Catholic couple with a shared mission: raise children who don't just know the faith, but live it. Chelsea came into the Church through OCIA, and together they discovered how hard it is to build Catholic culture at home when nobody has shown you what that looks like on a Tuesday.

Chelsea is a certified early-childhood educator who has taught both Pre-K and 2nd grade at a Catholic school. She knows exactly how children at every developmental stage learn and retain. When she designs an activity, it's a curriculum decision backed by years in the classroom — not a Pinterest guess.

John brings business, marketing, and a conviction that passing the faith to children deserves real intentionality. Together they built the kit they wished had existed.

OCIA Convert Certified Educator Seminary Review Catholic Family
What Makes Us Different

Five reasons no other kit compares.

Seminary
Reviewed

Every box is reviewed by a seminary professor of theology before it ships.

No other Catholic subscription box offers this. Every activity guide, saint card, prayer, and educational booklet is reviewed for fidelity to the Magisterium and the Catechism before it goes into your box. Open it with full confidence.

Educator-Designed, Not Mom-Designed

Chelsea is a certified early-childhood educator who teaches Pre-K and 2nd grade at a Catholic school. Every activity is built on developmental psychology. Your kids will engage, learn, and remember.

Liturgical Rhythm, Not Random Crafts

An ongoing rhythm tied to the full liturgical year — not one-off feast day downloads. Children grow up understanding every season has a shape, a color, a spirit, a practice.

Zero Prep. Open and Go.

Every supply is in the box. The guide tells you exactly what to do, in what order, with what talking points. Open Thursday at 7pm and run a beautiful family activity by 7:20.

Founded by OCIA Converts

We were our own first customer. We know what it feels like to be a new Catholic trying to build faith at home with no roadmap. This is what we wish had existed.

Curriculum-Grade Content, Not Pinterest Crafts

Built on early-childhood education principles — sequencing, repetition, multi-sensory engagement, age-appropriate vocabulary, formative discussion. The kind of catechesis a Catholic school takes two weeks to deliver, arriving in a box ready for tonight after dinner.

Mission

Why we exist.

Catholic Family Kit exists for one reason: to help ordinary families build a domestic church — with no theology degree required.

The Problem

The "now what?" moment after RCIA / OCIA.

Chelsea finished her conversion and had no idea how to actually live the faith at home. Pinterest wasn't enough. Parish programs ran on Sundays. Tuesday dinner table needed something different.

The Conviction

Catechesis belongs at the dinner table.

The Council Fathers called the family the ecclesia domestica — the domestic church. We took that literally. The home, not the parish hall, is where faith is formed.

The Build

Educator + theologian + entrepreneur.

Chelsea designs every activity using early-childhood pedagogy. A seminary professor reviews every kit. John runs the operation. Three roles, one kit, zero compromises.

Today

Helping families across the country.

Hundreds of Catholic families now use CFK to anchor their week. We're just getting started — and we'd love your family to join us.

What ages is Catholic Family Kit designed for?+

Designed for families with children ages 3–10. Chelsea builds each activity to work across this range — a 4-year-old and a 9-year-old can do the same activity at different depths. The Activity Guide includes discussion questions tiered by age. Many families tell us their 11–14 year olds engage equally well, especially in discussion.

When does the box ship? When will it arrive?+

We ship between the 25th–27th of each month via USPS Priority Mail so kits arrive by the 1st of the following month — giving you all month to use it in rhythm. Subscriptions renew on the 15th. If you subscribe after the 15th, your first physical kit ships the following month, but you receive that month's Digital Activity Guide immediately by email at no extra charge. All plans include free US shipping.

Can I cancel? Are there contracts?+

No contracts, ever. Cancel anytime before the 15th of the month and you won't be charged for the following box. Cancel after the 15th and you'll receive one more box (already billed) before your subscription ends. You can also skip individual months instead of canceling. Founding Member pricing is locked for as long as you maintain your subscription.

Is the content doctrinally accurate? How do I know?+

Every box is reviewed by a credentialed seminary professor of theology before it ships. Every activity guide, saint card, prayer, and educational booklet is checked for fidelity to the Magisterium and the Catechism of the Catholic Church. No other Catholic subscription box offers this level of theological oversight.

Do you offer one-time purchases (no subscription)?+

At this time, we focus on the subscription model so we can keep production tightly tied to the liturgical calendar and seminary review. If you'd like a single box as a trial, contact us and we'll send the current month's box at the regular monthly rate, no commitment.

Can I send a box as a gift?+

Absolutely — our boxes make wonderful gifts for godchildren, nieces and nephews, grandchildren, and fellow Catholic families. Enter the recipient's shipping address at checkout. You can gift individual boxes or purchase a prepaid annual subscription. The physicality of the box is intentional — it's part of the formation experience.

What is the Founding Member price lock?+

Founding Members lock in $39.95/mo for as long as they maintain an active subscription — even after we raise our regular price to $49.95/mo. Once Founding Member spots close, they're gone permanently. The rate lock applies to the same account and cannot be transferred. It's permanently forfeited if you cancel and re-subscribe later.

How long does an activity take?+

Most activities run 25–40 minutes including the discussion. Designed to fit between dinner and bedtime. The guide tells you exactly how long each piece takes so you can plan accordingly.

Do you ship internationally?+

Currently we ship to the contiguous 48 states with free shipping. Hawaii, Alaska, and US territories carry a small $6 surcharge. International shipping (Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia) is on our roadmap — email us to be added to the international waitlist.

My family is Eastern Catholic / Byzantine. Will this fit?+

The kit is designed around the Roman Rite liturgical calendar. Many Eastern Catholic families still find it valuable since the saints, virtues, and core catechesis are universal. We're working on Eastern Rite supplemental materials — contact us to be notified.

My box arrived damaged. What do I do?+

Email hello@catholicfamilykit.com within 7 days of delivery with a photo. We ship a replacement within 5 business days at no charge — full stop.

Can I include a gift note?+

Yes — at checkout there's a gift-note field. We hand-write a note onto a Catholic Family Kit gift card and tuck it into the box.

Shipping Policy

Last updated: May 2026

The short version: Every kit ships free to the contiguous 48 states, leaves our hands between the 25th–27th of the month, and arrives by the 1st. Subscribe by the 15th to receive that month's kit; subscribe after the 15th and we send you the Digital Activity Guide immediately while your first physical box ships next month.

1. Free Shipping

Every Catholic Family Kit subscription includes free standard shipping to any address in the contiguous United States (48 states). There are no shipping fees, handling fees, or hidden charges. The price you see is the price you pay.

2. Ship Window & Delivery Timeline

Kits ship between the 25th and 27th of each month via USPS Priority Mail. They are designed to arrive by the 1st of the following month, giving you a full liturgical month to enjoy your kit from the moment it arrives. USPS Priority Mail typically delivers in 2–5 business days.

You will receive a shipping confirmation email with your tracking number when your kit ships. Catholic Family Kit is not responsible for carrier delays once the package is in USPS possession.

3. Subscription Cutoff & Digital Welcome Bridge

Subscribe on or before the 15th: you receive that month's physical kit, shipped between the 25th–27th.

Subscribe after the 15th: your first physical kit will be the following month's kit — but you will receive the current month's Digital Activity Guide immediately by email at no extra charge. This ensures you receive value right away while your first physical kit is being prepared.

This cutoff is applied consistently and is determined by the timestamp on your subscription. There are no exceptions — we apply the rule uniformly so every family is treated fairly.

4. Hawaii, Alaska & US Territories

We ship to Hawaii, Alaska, Puerto Rico, and US territories via USPS Priority Mail. A shipping surcharge of $6.00 applies to these locations due to higher carrier costs. This surcharge will be displayed at checkout before payment is finalized.

5. International Shipping

We do not currently ship internationally. Email hello@catholicfamilykit.com to be added to our international waitlist and we will notify you when international shipping becomes available.

6. Damaged Kits

If your kit arrives damaged, email hello@catholicfamilykit.com within 7 days of the delivery date with a photograph of the damage. We will ship a replacement kit at no charge within 5 business days. We reserve the right to request the damaged kit be returned before issuing a replacement at our discretion.

7. Lost or Missing Kits

If tracking shows "Delivered" but you have not received your kit, please first check with neighbors, building management, and all household members, and allow 48 hours from the delivery scan. If the kit remains missing after 48 hours, email hello@catholicfamilykit.com. We will file a USPS claim and ship a replacement if the loss is confirmed.

Catholic Family Kit is not liable for packages confirmed delivered by USPS to the address on file.

8. Address Changes

To update your shipping address, email hello@catholicfamilykit.com or update it in your account portal on or before the 15th of the month. Address updates received after the 15th take effect the following month's shipment. We cannot redirect packages already in transit. Catholic Family Kit is not responsible for shipments delivered to an outdated address that was not updated by the 15th deadline.

9. Returns

Due to the perishable and personalized nature of our monthly kits, we do not accept returns of shipped and delivered kits. If you believe you received the wrong kit or a kit with missing items, contact us within 7 days of delivery and we will make it right.

10. Cancellations

To cancel your subscription, log into your account portal or email hello@catholicfamilykit.com on or before the 15th of the month. Cancellations received after the 15th take effect after your next kit ships. You will not receive a refund for a kit that has already been assembled and shipped. Annual subscribers who cancel mid-year are not entitled to a pro-rata refund after the kit for that month has shipped.

11. Limitation of Liability

Catholic Family Kit's liability for any shipping-related claim is limited to the value of the subscription kit for that month. Catholic Family Kit is not liable for indirect, consequential, or incidental damages arising from shipping delays, carrier errors, or address discrepancies provided by the subscriber. By subscribing, you agree to these terms.

Questions? Contact us or call (832) 525-2593 Monday–Friday, 8am–4pm CT.

Returns, Refunds & Cancellation Policy

Last updated: May 2026

In plain language: Cancel by the 15th and no further kits ship. Cancel after the 15th and one final kit ships before your subscription ends. Kits that have already shipped cannot be returned or refunded — but if anything is wrong with yours, we will always make it right.

1. No Returns on Shipped Kits

Due to the perishable and personalized nature of our monthly liturgical kits, we do not accept returns of shipped and delivered kits. Activity guides, saint cards, prayer cards, craft supplies, and seasonal décor cannot be resold once dispatched. All sales are final once a kit has shipped.

If you received the wrong kit or a kit with missing items, contact us within 7 days of delivery and we will make it right. See "Damaged Kits" in our Shipping Policy.

2. Subscription Cancellation Rules

Cancel on or before the 15th of the month: your subscription ends immediately. No further charge. No kit ships.

Cancel after the 15th: that month's kit has already been billed and assembled. It will ship on the 25th–27th as normal. Your subscription then ends — no further kits or charges follow.

You may also skip individual months rather than canceling outright. Skip requests must be received before the 15th cutoff for that month.

3. No Refunds on Processed Payments

Monthly subscription payments are non-refundable once processed on the 15th. Annual subscription payments are non-refundable after the first kit for the year has shipped. Annual subscribers who cancel mid-year are not entitled to a pro-rata refund after any individual month's kit has shipped.

4. Founding Member Rate — Important Notice

Founding Members who cancel their subscription permanently forfeit the $39.95/month locked rate. Re-subscribing after cancellation is at the then-current regular rate. The Founding rate is non-transferable and applies only to the original, continuously-active account.

5. How to Cancel

Email hello@catholicfamilykit.com with "Cancel Subscription" in the subject line, including the email address on your account. You may also call (832) 525-2593 Monday–Friday, 8am–4pm CT. We process cancellations within one business day and send written confirmation.

6. Damaged or Wrong Kits

If your kit arrives damaged, defective, or contains the wrong items, email us within 7 days of delivery with a photograph. We ship a replacement at no charge within 5 business days. Full details in our Shipping Policy.

Need help? Contact us or call (832) 525-2593. We're a small Catholic family business and we're here to make it right.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 2026 · Effective: May 2026

Catholic Family Kit® ("CFK", "we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes the personal information we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding it. By using our website or subscribing, you agree to the practices described here.

  2. How We Use Information
  3. Payment Information

1. Information We Collect

We collect only what we need to fulfill your subscription and provide our service:

  • Account Information: Name, email address, password (hashed).
  • Shipping Information: Mailing address, recipient name, optional phone number.
  • Payment Information: Processed exclusively through Stripe; we never see, store, or transmit credit card details on our servers.
  • Communication Records: Emails, contact form submissions, customer service interactions.
  • Usage Data: Pages visited, browser type, referring source, IP address (for security and analytics).

2. How We Use Information

We use your information to:

  • Process subscriptions, payments, and ship kits.
  • Communicate about your account, shipments, and service updates.
  • Send occasional marketing emails (only if you've opted in; unsubscribe anytime).
  • Respond to inquiries and provide customer support.
  • Detect fraud, prevent abuse, and improve the service.
  • Comply with legal obligations.

3. Payment Information

All payments are processed by Stripe, a PCI-DSS Level 1 certified payment processor. CFK never stores, transmits, or has access to your full credit card number, CVV, or expiration date. Stripe's privacy practices are described at stripe.com/privacy.

4. Sharing & Disclosure

We do not sell your personal information. We share information only with:

  • Service providers who help us operate (Stripe for payments, USPS for shipping, EmailJS / SendGrid for email, AWS for hosting).
  • Legal requests when required by court order, subpoena, or law.
  • Business transfers in the event of a merger or acquisition (you'll be notified in writing).

5. Cookies & Tracking

We use cookies for essential site functionality (cart, login, language preferences) and limited analytics (Google Analytics). See our Cookie Policy for the full list and your opt-out options.

6. Children's Privacy (COPPA)

Catholic Family Kit is designed for use by children but is purchased and managed exclusively by adults. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13. Account creation requires being 18 or older. If you believe we have inadvertently collected information from a child, contact us immediately and we will delete it.

7. Data Security

We use industry-standard safeguards including TLS encryption in transit, encrypted backups at rest, hashed passwords (bcrypt), restricted internal access, and regular security reviews. No system is perfectly secure, but we work hard to protect your data and will notify you within 72 hours if a breach affects your information.

8. Your Rights (CCPA, GDPR, State Laws)

Depending on your jurisdiction, you have the right to:

  • Access the personal information we hold about you.
  • Correct inaccurate information.
  • Delete your account and personal information ("right to be forgotten").
  • Export your data in a portable format.
  • Opt out of marketing communications.
  • Object to certain processing.

To exercise any right, email hello@catholicfamilykit.com with "Privacy Request" in the subject. We respond within 30 days. We will never charge or retaliate against you for exercising a privacy right.

9. Data Retention

We retain account information for as long as you have an active subscription, plus seven years thereafter for tax and accounting purposes. Marketing email preferences are retained until you unsubscribe. Anonymous analytics may be retained indefinitely.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated by email and a banner on the site at least 14 days before they take effect. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance.

11. Contact Us

Privacy questions or concerns: hello@catholicfamilykit.com · (832) 525-2593 · Catholic Family Kit, Houston, Texas, USA.

Cookie Policy

Last updated: May 2026

This Cookie Policy explains how Catholic Family Kit® uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on catholicfamilykit.com.

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They help the site remember your preferences, keep you logged in, and provide basic analytics.

Cookies We Use

Essential (always on)

  • session — keeps you logged in and remembers your cart. Expires after 30 days.
  • csrf_token — prevents cross-site request forgery on form submissions.
  • cookie_consent — remembers your cookie preference choice.

Analytics (opt-in)

  • _ga, _ga_* (Google Analytics) — anonymous traffic analytics. Helps us understand which pages families find useful. IP addresses are anonymized.

Marketing

We currently do not use third-party marketing or retargeting cookies. We will update this Cookie Policy and obtain explicit consent before introducing any.

Managing Cookies

You can disable cookies in your browser settings at any time. Note: disabling essential cookies will break account login and checkout. To opt out of Google Analytics specifically, install the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

Do Not Track

We honor browser "Do Not Track" signals by disabling analytics for that session.

Questions? Contact us · hello@catholicfamilykit.com

Accessibility Statement

Last updated: May 2026

Catholic Family Kit® is committed to making our website and products accessible to all members of the Body of Christ — including those with disabilities. We strive to meet WCAG 2.1 Level AA standards and continuously work to improve.

What We've Done

  • Semantic HTML structure with proper heading hierarchy.
  • Alt text on meaningful images.
  • Keyboard navigation throughout the site.
  • Sufficient color contrast on text and interactive elements.
  • Forms with clear labels and error messages.
  • Resizable text without loss of content.

Kit Accessibility

Our printed materials use legible serif and sans-serif typefaces at minimum 11pt body, large-print options for prayer cards, and high-contrast illustrations. We're piloting Braille and audio-format Activity Guides — contact us if you'd like to be a beta tester.

Reporting an Accessibility Issue

If you encounter an accessibility barrier, please email hello@catholicfamilykit.com with the subject "Accessibility" and a description. We respond within 2 business days and prioritize accessibility fixes.
